summary: Prepare a bounded Chinese decision checklist for scoring existing Robot answers; read-only, no scoring execution.

payload.mission: Prepare decision material for evaluating already-generated Robot answers by reading the local vendored controller, existing scoring code and parameter definitions, saved run artifacts, and only the two existing node01 run configs/answer fields/annotation format/logging flags if needed. Do not generate answers or score them.
payload.authorization_source: Current user message requesting a bounded L0 scoring-preparation task.
authorized_now: Read existing local vendored controller/scoring scripts and parameter definitions.
Read saved answer/annotation artifacts needed to identify fields and counts.
If required, use existing SSH to read only config, answer-field schema, annotation format, and logging flags for the two named Robot runs.
Write a short Chinese decision-preparation checklist and this L0 result, reduce sidecar state, validate, and push through the already-authorized repository sync.
authorized_only_if: Use node01 only if the local material cannot answer the five requested questions.
Keep all server reads to the two existing run directories and their referenced saved files.
hard_prohibitions: Do not run scoring scripts, judges, models, API requests, re-embedding, inference, GPU tests, or any preflight entrypoint.
Do not create new answers or labels.
Do not read, print, configure, or upload credential values.
Do not edit remote files or processes.
Do not change split, metric, judge, protocol, or scientific state.
Do not create or execute L3/L4 tasks or approvals.
Do not mark any unconfirmed samples as an independent holdout.
required_tests: Run the existing ResearchOps validator after reducer processing.
required_preflight: Check the named task ID for duplication before registering it.
Inspect only the scoped local code/saved artifacts and, if needed, the two named runs on node01.
required_outputs: Answer the five requested scoring-readiness questions with field names/counts and clear unknowns.
Save one concise Chinese preparation checklist and L0 RESULT.
stop_conditions: Stop when the requested code and record fields have been checked; do not expand to a full repository or server audit.
If an answer cannot be supported from existing saved material, state the exact evidence gap and stop.
Never execute a scoring/evaluation or any listed prohibited action.
